title: Sofic actions, halo products, and metric approximations of groups
summary: We introduce the notion of a ``sofic $\mathcal{C}$-action'' of one group on another by automorphisms, for $\mathcal{C}$ a class of groups. We show that if $\mathcal{C}$ is the class of (i) sofic, (ii) hyperlinear, (iii) linear sofic or (iv) weakly sofic groups, then the class $\mathcal{C}$ is closed under taking semidirect products with sofic $\mathcal{C}$-action. We use this to construct a wide variety of new examples of groups in the classes (i)-(iv), many of them arising as ``halo products'' in the sense of Genevois-Tessera.
